quote_text: Earlier, Shah Mahmood Qureshi, Pakistan's Foreign Minister told the UNHRC - which stands for United Nations Human Rights Council - that India had converted Jammu Kashmir (J&K) into a Union territory. The Indian government did not follow provisions made in the Constitution and made J&K a Union Territory. People in J&K are suffering and India is violating their Human Rights. There is a communication blockade in the entire region as well. The people of J&K were kept in the dark and not given any information regarding the conversion of J&K into a Union Territory. Qureshi urged a UN-led committee to investigate J&K's suffering and violence by India. At the 42nd UNHRC meeting, Vijay Thakur Singh, who is an official of East Ministry of External Affairs said that, Pakistan's statements about problems in J&K are complete lies. She even said that Qureshi's statements about problems and communication blockade in J&K are complete lies. Vijay said that the Indian government converted J&K into a Union Territory by following the constitution step by step. To maintain security and peace in J&K, the Indian government worked very hard and then made it a Union territory to keep the people safe. Vijay said that Pakistan lying about the situation in J&K is nothing new. They have been doing it for years. The entire world knows that Pakistan is the centre of terrorism. Pakistan's government has allowed them to remain there They haven't taken any steps to catch them or remove the terrorists. Vijay said that if there are issues between India and Pakistan, it will only be solved by the two of them. India will not accept any country's interference. After the abrogation of Article 370, people of J&K will benefit a lot. The Indian law gives the states rights such as gender equality, rights to minors, RTE - Right to Education, RTI - Right to Information and RTW - Right to Work, etc. These Laws were applicable all over India except J&K. After the abrogation of Article 370, these laws will be applicable in J&K people of J&K will benefit. The United Nations General Assembly will be held in New York on 27th September PM Modi and PM Imran Khan will both be speaking on the same day. The whole world is excited to see what happens on 27th September.
title: India Slams Pakistan Over J&K Lies
